subject.title: feat: audit PR review convergence at exact head

question: Should OpenClaw maintain this repository-local exact-head convergence audit as a supported automation surface, or should equivalent logic remain solely in the existing ClawSweeper review/proof workflow?
rationale: The implementation is a new policy-bearing automation surface, not a narrow repair; source-level correctness alone cannot determine whether two readiness decision paths are intended to coexist.

options.title: Adopt a canonical repository audit
options.body: Define the supported caller, ownership, and relationship to ClawSweeper, then refresh the branch and resolve the current exact-head checks.

options.title: Keep the logic in ClawSweeper
options.body: Avoid a parallel repository script and close or narrow the PR to any reusable helper that the existing workflow demonstrably needs.

recommendation.title: Adopt a canonical repository audit
recommendation.body: Define the supported caller, ownership, and relationship to ClawSweeper, then refresh the branch and resolve the current exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed behavior is tightly coupled to the bot’s verdict markers and proof-policy integration, although a human automation owner must make the final product decision.
